1.consolidated_definition: Árbol de hasta 45 m de altura, de copa grande, tronco grisáceo, con franjas verticales amarillentas, hojas simples, opuestas, envés más claro que el haz y borde ondulado, flores blancas o amarillentas, cuyo fruto es una baya carnosa de color verde. (Clusiaceae; Calophyllum brasiliense).
1.en_consolidated_definition: Tree reaching heights of up to 45 m, with a large canopy, greyish trunk featuring vertical yellowish stripes, simple and opposite leaves with a lighter underside than the upper surface and wavy margins, white or yellow flowers, and a fleshy green berry as its fruit (Clusiaceae; Calophyllum brasiliense).
